meta.subject: fixed l3cache hang using memory arbiter in afu

en.summary: This is a real hardware hang fix on the AFU off-chip memory path. The patch stops sharing the AVS memory port through ad hoc top-level multiplexing and instead inserts a tagged memory arbiter plus an AVS wrapper with explicit outstanding-read tracking, so Vortex/L3 traffic and CCI copy traffic can safely coexist.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says it fixes an L3 cache hang using a memory arbiter in the AFU.
The patch changes top-level hardware datapath and response-routing logic on the shared memory interface.
The new logic adds source tagging, request arbitration, response demultiplexing, and outstanding-read bookkeeping, which are all correctness mechanisms rather than performance-only cleanup.
disqualifiers: The commit is large and also includes interface renames, cleanup, and unrelated supporting edits.
The bug fix is architectural and spread across multiple files, so the minimal reinjection target must be narrower than a full reverse patch.
evidence: hw/opae/vortex_afu.sv now routes CCI DRAM traffic and Vortex DRAM traffic through VX_mem_arb instead of direct manual AVS sharing.
The new hw/opae/VX_avs_wrapper.v queues request tags and read data and tracks avs_pending_reads before asserting dram_req_ready.
hw/rtl/VX_mem_arb.v appends the request source index to the outgoing tag and uses that index to demultiplex responses back to the correct requester.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When two independent masters share one off-chip memory port, correctness depends on more than request-side muxing. The design also needs a consistent way to tag responses with their source, route returned data back to the right client, and limit outstanding reads on the external interface. If two traffic classes share the port through ad hoc multiplexing without unified response tagging and queue accounting, concurrent traffic can misassociate responses or deadlock each other, which is consistent with an L3/AFU hang.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: shared memory-port source tagging and response routing
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Two masters, such as host DMA or copy traffic and cache-generated memory traffic, issue overlapping requests to one shared external memory interface.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Bypass or weaken the shared arbiter/wrapper so requests from different sources no longer carry reliable source identity and unified outstanding-read accounting through the shared memory port.
portability_notes: This applies to any DUT where a cache/memory subsystem and a sideband DMA or host-copy path share one AXI, AVS, or similar memory port.
If the target DUT already uses a general interconnect, reintroduce the bug by removing source-ID propagation or by merging the read-return queues incorrectly rather than deleting the whole fabric.
The portable bug is about response ownership and outstanding-read bookkeeping, not about the AVS protocol specifically.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the shared external memory port that is used by two logically separate request sources.
Remove or disable the logic that appends a source selector to outgoing request tags, or stop using that selector when routing responses back.
Allow both sources to share one read-return queue or one pending-read budget without preserving per-source ownership.
Keep concurrent traffic generation enabled so the overlap between the two sources can expose response mix-ups or liveness loss.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AFU AVS arbitration between Vortex DRAM traffic and CCI copy traffic
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix inserts VX_mem_arb between the two request sources and the external AVS port, encodes source identity into the request tag, and uses VX_avs_wrapper to queue read tags/data and track outstanding reads on the AVS side.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In vortex_afu.sv, the shared AVS path now goes through vx_cci_avs_arb and avs_wrapper. VX_mem_arb.v appends REQS_BITS of source ID to request tags and demultiplexes responses by those bits.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Under concurrent AFU copy traffic and cache traffic, memory responses can return to the wrong source or one traffic class can consume the shared read budget incorrectly, leading to corrupted transfers or an L3/AFU hang.
evidence_for_injection: VX_mem_arb.v explicitly concatenates the requester index onto the outgoing tag and uses the low tag bits to select the response destination.
VX_avs_wrapper.v adds separate read-tag and read-data queues plus avs_pending_reads-based flow control, which indicates prior sharing was not safely tracked.
The subject line directly ties the bug symptom to an l3cache hang in the AFU memory path.
notes: This entry remains a DUT bug-fix, but the patch is broad, so the reinjection plan should target source tagging and response ownership rather than reverting every surrounding refactor.
If another DUT does not expose source IDs in tags, use whatever equivalent metadata it uses to route responses back to the original requester.

zh.summary: 这是 AFU 片外内存路径上的真实硬件 hang 修复。补丁不再通过临时的顶层复用逻辑共享 AVS 内存端口，而是插入带 tag 的 memory arbiter 和带显式未完成读跟踪的 AVS wrapper，使 Vortex/L3 流量与 CCI copy 流量能够安全并存。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确写明是在 AFU 中用 memory arbiter 修复 L3 cache hang。
补丁修改的是共享内存接口上的顶层硬件数据路径与响应路由逻辑。
新增逻辑包含源标记、请求仲裁、响应分发和未完成读计数，这些都是正确性机制，而不是纯性能清理。
disqualifiers: 该提交体量很大，还包含接口重命名、清理和其他辅助性修改。
修复是体系结构级别的，分散在多个文件中，因此最小的回注点必须比整提交回退更聚焦。
evidence: hw/opae/vortex_afu.sv 现在通过 VX_mem_arb 来仲裁 CCI DRAM 流量和 Vortex DRAM 流量，而不是手工直接共享 AVS。
新增的 hw/opae/VX_avs_wrapper.v 会对请求 tag 和读返回数据排队，并在拉高 dram_req_ready 前跟踪 avs_pending_reads。
hw/rtl/VX_mem_arb.v 会把请求源索引拼接进输出 tag，并在响应返回时用该索引把数据分发回正确请求方。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当两个独立 master 共享一个片外内存端口时，仅做请求侧复用是不够的。设计还必须能为响应保留来源身份、把返回数据路由回正确客户端，并对外部接口上的未完成读进行统一限流。如果两个流量类别通过临时复用逻辑共享端口，却没有统一的响应标记和队列计数，那么并发流量就可能把响应送错对象，或在背压下互相卡死，这与 L3/AFU hang 的症状一致。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 共享内存端口的源标记与响应回送
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 两个 master，例如 host DMA 或 copy 流量与 cache 产生的内存流量，同时向同一个共享外部内存接口发请求。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 绕过或削弱共享 arbiter/wrapper，使不同来源的请求在穿过共享端口时不再携带可靠的源身份，也不再共享统一的未完成读计数。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 绕过带 tag 的仲裁层
portability_notes: 适用于 cache/内存子系统与旁路 DMA 或 host-copy 路径共享同一个 AXI、AVS 或类似内存端口的 DUT。
如果目标 DUT 已经使用通用互连，可通过去掉 source ID 传播或错误合并读返回队列来重引入该 bug，而不必删除整个互连结构。
可移植的核心 bug 是“响应归属和未完成读记账错误”，而不是 AVS 协议本身。
concrete_injection_steps: 找出被两个逻辑独立请求源共享的外部内存端口。
删除或禁用给外发请求 tag 追加 source selector 的逻辑，或者在返回路由时不再使用该 selector。
让两个来源共享同一个读返回队列或同一个 pending-read 预算，但不保留来源归属。
保留并发流量生成能力，使两个来源的重叠请求能够暴露响应串扰或活性丢失。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AFU 中 Vortex DRAM 流量与 CCI copy 流量之间的 AVS 仲裁逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在两个请求源与外部 AVS 端口之间插入了 VX_mem_arb，把来源身份编码进请求 tag，并使用 VX_avs_wrapper 对 AVS 侧读 tag、读数据和未完成读数进行统一管理。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 vortex_afu.sv 中，共享 AVS 路径现在经过 vx_cci_avs_arb 和 avs_wrapper。VX_mem_arb.v 会把请求源 REQS_BITS 拼接进 tag，并在返回时按这些位选择响应去向。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在 AFU copy 流量与 cache 流量并发时，内存响应可能返回给错误来源，或者某一路流量错误占用共享读预算，最终导致数据损坏或 L3/AFU hang。
evidence_for_injection: VX_mem_arb.v 明确把 requester index 拼到输出 tag 上，并用低位 tag 选择响应目标。
VX_avs_wrapper.v 新增独立的读 tag 队列、读数据队列和 avs_pending_reads 限流，这说明此前的共享方式无法安全跟踪。
提交标题直接把 bug 症状绑定为 AFU 内存路径上的 l3cache hang。
notes: 该条目仍然属于 DUT bug-fix，但补丁较大，因此回注时应聚焦于 source tagging 和响应归属，而不是盲目回退整组重构。
如果另一个 DUT 不通过 tag 暴露 source ID，就用其等价的响应归属元数据来做同类故障注入。
